messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: GPU pool "ap-southeast-3-gpu-pool-2" nearing exhaustion — queue=812 inflight=795 pool_size=9 max_allowed=9 token_latency_p95=7.4s errors=429. Paging: @Mira @Sam @Kai @oncall-sre

Mira: ack, oncall. opening incident channel. quick ask: is this the same pool that had spikes last month? @Sam

Sam: not the same. metrics show sustained ingest surge from a new A/B test starting at 2026-03-29T02:12:00Z. autoscaler attempted scale-ups 5 times and kept hitting hard cap.

Kai: account-level limit is 9 for this pool. cloud reports low spare capacity in ap-southeast-3, but partner zone has 2 spare GPUs. I'll start emergency provisioning (REQ-9003).

Mira: Elena, pull impacted customer list and SLAs. prioritize anything with 99.9+.

Elena: pulling... top impacted services: payments-proxy (480 queued, SLA=99.95), analytics-batch (220 queued), discover-search (170 queued). Also ~8k PLG requests failing with 429s.

Sam: autoscaler log:
```
2026-03-29T02:18:33Z ERROR autoscaler: ScaleUpRejected pool=ap-southeast-3-gpu-pool-2 reason="hard_cap"
```

Mira: plan: (1) apply non-SLA fallback to quantized model, (2) evict low-priority background batches, (3) request emergency nodes, (4) soft-throttle new PLG traffic. Sam/Kai own parts.

Sam: applying fallback routing now for non-SLA:
```
redwood route override --pool ap-southeast-3-gpu-pool-2 --scope=non-sla --model=redwood/qa-1.3q
```

ops-bot: ACTION: route override applied by Sam at 2026-03-29T02:21:10Z. Non-SLA -> redwood/qa-1.3q

Elena: CSMs pinged for payments-proxy and analytics-batch. sending brief advisory now.

Sam: kicking eviction script for low-priority jobs:
```
./tools/evict_low_priority --pool ap-southeast-3-gpu-pool-2 --priority-cutoff=50
```

Kai: REQ-9003 submitted to partner zone; provisioning ETA ~9m. starting cloud quota bump flow.

oncall-sre: taking the page in 7. Mira please handoff current mitigations and any blockers.

Mira: handoff summary:
- route override applied for non-SLA
- eviction running, ~260 background jobs evicted so far
- emergency provisioning requested (REQ-9003)
- CSMs notified
- monitoring queue/latency

Sam: noticed model-cache thrash on payments-proxy increasing CPU/GPU work. pinning hot KV prefixes and bumping cache TTLs for that tenant.

Kai: cloud returns 2 nodes in initializing state. one node failed to join due to kubelet crash on boot (kernel mismatch). reimaging now.

Sam: reimage command:
```
cloudctl instance reimage node-34 --image kubelet-v1.24
```

ops-bot: CLOUD: provisioning event REQ-9003 accepted at 2026-03-29T02:29:22Z.

Sam: node-34 reimaged; both nodes reporting Ready at 2026-03-29T02:36:09Z. pool size now 11 (max_allowed temporarily bumped to 11).

ops-bot: POOL UPDATE: ap-southeast-3-gpu-pool-2 size=11 at 2026-03-29T02:36:45Z

Sam: queue dropped: 812 -> 74 over 18 minutes after mitigations and node attach. token_latency_p95 reduced to 1.4s. dropping_requests=false.

Mira: switching to recovery posture. set monitoring alert to watch for ingestion spikes and automated fallback triggers. also schedule postmortem.

Elena: incident ticket IC-2026-287 created. customer outreach logged: payments-proxy CSM to follow up tomorrow. added count: ~8k 429s during 20m window.

Mira: immediate action items:
1) Add alert at 80% of max_allowed for each pool. owner=Observability, due=2026-04-01
2) Create emergency-burst runbook for partner-zone provisioning. owner=Kai, due=2026-04-02
3) Autoscaler robustness: improve attach retries and detect kubelet image mismatches early. owner=Sam, due=2026-03-31
4) Route policy: ensure fallback doesn't route SLA traffic to smaller models. owner=Product, due=2026-04-05
5) Customer comms template for capacity events. owner=Elena, due=2026-04-03

Kai: opening infra PR to make pool caps configurable with guardrails. will include post-deploy checks.

Sam: will add unit/integration tests for attach and image validation, and add more telemetry on cache miss rates.

oncall-sre: Handoff at 2026-03-29T02:45:00Z. monitoring for 3 hours. page closed. :white_check_mark:

Mira: thanks everyone. closing active incident channel. please add any logs or follow-ups to IC-2026-287.
extra_notes: This thread documents live mitigation for GPU pool exhaustion due to an ingestion surge from an A/B test; includes emergency provisioning, fallback routing, evictions, node reimage, and post-incident action items.
